messages:
Tess (Sales): AcmeSec signed NDA. They want an on-prem sealed POC: offline bundle signed, monthly sec patches, emergency hotfix SLA (72h), and a single upfront packaging fee. who owns signing keys?
Omar (Solutions Eng): we can produce a minibundle (quantized weights + slim runtime). prefer cosign signatures. if customer insists we escrow keys -> legal + AAR required. need customer confirmation of allowed kernel/libc/driver versions.
Lee (Security): cosign ok. telemetry disabled by default for sealed builds. if keys are escrowed we need POA + contract clause. also need acceptance test vectors for any hotfix.
Sam (SRE): ops flag: transfer bandwidth is the blocker. estimated bundle sizes: model 10-14GB, runtime ~1GB. recommend rsync with binary deltas for updates. rollback supported via operator version pin + forced revert script.
Tess (Sales): pricing ask: how to break out monthly security patches vs quarterly feature rollouts vs emergency 72h fixes?
Omar (Solutions Eng): pricing approach: one-time packaging & signing fee (eng + QA) + per-delta update fee + expedited hotfix surcharge. ballpark: initial package $9k-$16k; per-delta $1.2k-$2.5k; emergency 72h surcharge +50%. will provide formal quote.
Lee (Security): we'll prepare AAR template, telemetry opt-out wording, and list of masked fields for customer review.
Sam (SRE): CI note: ci-bot kicked sealed-bundle build -> https://ci.redwood.example/builds/812 :gear:
ci-bot: build started for sealed-bundle/2026-04-01, artifacts to GCS staging (sha256 manifest will be attached).
Tess (Sales): next steps: 1) Omar to publish exact OS/libc/driver constraints + sample manifest by EOD; 2) Lee to share AAR + acceptance tests; 3) Sam to draft transfer bandwidth checklist, rollback playbook and emergency hotfix SLA language. I'll update the SOW and sync with AcmeSec.
Omar (Solutions Eng): will post manifest snippet and delta workflow today.
ci-bot: build complete, sha256: a3f5... (manifest attached).
Tess (Sales): thanks team :thumbsup:
thread_context: sealed-datacenter POC: packaging, signing, upgrade cadence, emergency hotfix path, pricing
